steps: Fry the diced chicken until cooked through, then set it aside.
Soften the onion and mushrooms, add the rice and toast it for 1 minute.
Pour in the white wine and stir until it is absorbed.
Add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 18 minutes.
Stir in the chicken and the parmesan.
pitfalls: Cold stock stops the rice cooking evenly.

previous.question: What can I substitute here?
previous.answer: Use an extra ladle of the hot chicken stock instead of the wine, with a squeeze of lemon juice for the acidity the wine would give. Add it the same way and stir until it is absorbed.
